create_read_squad_examples: read a SQuAD json file into a list of SquadExample objects for training or evaluation
build_convert_examples_to_features: convert SquadExample objects into InputFeatures with tokenized sequences and attention masks for BERT
create_write_predictions: write model predictions for SQuAD QA answers to JSON files with n-best candidates and null scores
create_write_predictions_extended: write XLNet-style SQuAD predictions with top-k start/end spans and optimal answer threshold evaluation
create_get_final_text: project tokenized prediction text back to the original document text using character alignment
